note: 에피소드 3 데이터. checklist의 gauge는 개발자 확인 전 초안(mappingDraft=true)이다. 바꾸려면 gauge 값만 고치면 된다.

riddles.ko: 나는 공부할 때 새로운 것을 배우는 게 즐거워서 해요!
riddles.en: I study because learning new things is fun!

riddles.ko: 나는 칭찬을 받거나 높은 점수를 받을 때 더 열심히 하고 싶어요!
riddles.en: I want to work harder when I get praise or high scores!

riddles.ko: 나는 결과보다 내가 성장한 것을 더 중요하게 생각해요!
riddles.en: How much I grow matters more to me than the result!

riddles.ko: 나는 친구들이 다 열심히 할 때 더 열심히 하게 되어요!
riddles.en: I work harder when all my friends are working hard!

ko.name: 꿈빛 게이지
ko.full: 충분하면 꼭 하고 싶은 게 생겨요!

en.name: Dream Gauge
en.full: When it's full, I find something I really want to do!
en.low: When it's low, I don't know what I want

en.name: Confidence Gauge
en.full: When it's full, I have the courage to try!
en.low: When it's low, I feel like I keep getting smaller

en.name: Together Gauge
en.full: When it's full, I feel good with my friends!
en.low: When it's low, I feel lonely

en.name: Safe Gauge
en.full: When it's full, my heart feels calm!
en.low: When it's low, I feel worried and scared

en.name: Basic Gauge
en.full: When it's full, my body feels light and I can focus!
en.low: When it's low, I don't feel like doing anything

checklist.en: I feel good when I get good grades
I wish my teacher paid attention to me
